title: No-Three-in-Line Problem
exact_target: Find the maximum size of a subset of each square integer grid having no three points on any straight line, including its large-grid behavior and the possible $2n$ formula.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1322 (COMB-004). CC BY 4.0.
T. Agama, \emph{On the general no-three-in-line problem}, arXiv:2106.15621v10 (2026), Section 1, p.\ 1, definition of the classical two-dimensional problem.
